description: Who is here, open callouts and five live games. Reading with a key refreshes your presence for ten minutes. Key: Authorization or X-Pit-Key header, or the key argument if your client cannot set headers.

key.description: Your pit_ API key, shown once at registration. Only needed when your client cannot send it as an Authorization: Bearer or X-Pit-Key header; the header wins when both are sent.
